A name tag must be renamed in an anvil before it can be used on a mob.
A renamed spawn egg spawns a mob with that name.
Names can be up to 30 characters in Bedrock Edition.
Renaming costs 1 level plus any prior-work penalty. A rename-only job costs at most 39 levels.
Leave the name blank to restore the item's default name.
Named items do not stack with unnamed or differently named items.
Chests, barrels, furnaces, hoppers, shulker boxes, brewing stands and enchanting tables show their name in their screen once placed.
